BiblicalUsage: Zaphon was a town in the valley, in the land given to the tribe of Gad beyond the Jordan. It stands in the allotment list beside Beth-nimrah and Succoth, on the border of the kingdom of Sihon. It is named once, as a boundary town of Gad's inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the boundary towns matter because God's gifts have borders, and Gad's inheritance was measured out by God. Zaphon is one of the markers of a promise kept.
